instruction: Remain relaxed. Keep the same resting head, jaw and lip pose.
Smile with the LEFT mouth corner; keep your head still.
Smile with the RIGHT mouth corner; keep your head still.
Smile with BOTH mouth corners; keep your head still.
Gently inflate the LEFT cheek with air; do not blow out.
Gently inflate the RIGHT cheek with air; do not blow out.
Gently inflate BOTH cheeks with air; do not blow out.
